<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

DeepEP v1 currently keeps a single process-wide buffer in `DeepEPBuffer` (`deepep_ep_state`). When the target and a speculative draft MoE share one process but use different expert configs (`num_experts` / `hidden_size` / `num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank`), the second model reuses the first buffer and can get a wrong size or QP layout.

Typical case: speculative decoding (e.g. DSpark) where the draft has fewer experts than the target, and both use DeepEP.

With no DSpark, or when DSpark and the target share the same key, behavior stays equivalent to the previous single-buffer path.

**Trade-off:** different target/draft keys mean multiple DeepEP buffers and thus higher GPU memory.

## Modifications

- Replace the single `deepep_ep_state` with a keyed `deepep_ep_registry` on `ctx.resources`
- Key each buffer by `(num_experts, hidden_size, num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank)`; allocate on miss, reuse on hit
- Log when allocating an additional buffer while other keys already exist (typical target + draft)
- Update `clean_buffer` / dispatch-mode transitions to operate over all registry entries
- Unit tests: update mode-transition / reset coverage; add multi-key (target vs draft) cleanup coverage

## Test plan

- [x] `pytest test/registered/unit/test_runtime_context.py::TestEpBufferState -q`

+        key = DeepEPBuffer._buffer_key(256, 7168, 128)
+        reg.by_key[key] = SimpleNamespace(
+            buffer=_FakeBuffer(),

+            num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank=128,
+            num_experts=256,
+        )
 
         DeepEPBuffer.set_dispatch_mode_as_normal()
         # NORMAL -> LOW_LATENCY must clean the low-latency buffer once.
@@ -1398,7 +1403,53 @@ def clean_low_latency_buffer(self, *args):
         self.assertEqual(len(cleans), 1)
 
         reset_context()
-        self.assertIsNone(DeepEPBuffer._state().buffer)
+        self.assertEqual(DeepEPBuffer._registry().by_key, {})
+
+    def test_deepep_buffers_are_keyed_by_num_experts(self):
+        """Target + DSpark draft with different expert counts need distinct
+        DeepEP Buffer entries in the same process."""
+        try:
+            from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+            from sglang.srt.layers.moe.token_dispatcher.deepep import DeepEPBuffer
+        except ImportError:
+            self.skipTest("deep_ep not installed")
+
+        reset_context()
+        cleans = []
+
+        class _FakeBuffer:
+            low_latency_mode = True
+
+            def __init__(self, tag):
+                self.tag = tag
+
+            def clean_low_latency_buffer(self, *args):
+                cleans.append((self.tag, args))
+
+        reg = DeepEPBuffer._registry()
+        target_key = DeepEPBuffer._buffer_key(256, 7168, 128)
+        draft_key = DeepEPBuffer._buffer_key(64, 7168, 128)
+        reg.by_key[target_key] = SimpleNamespace(
+            buffer=_FakeBuffer("target"),
+            hidden_size=7168,
+            num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank=128,
+            num_experts=256,
+        )
+        reg.by_key[draft_key] = SimpleNamespace(
+            buffer=_FakeBuffer("draft"),
+            hidden_size=7168,
+            num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank=128,
+            num_experts=64,
+        )
+
+        self.assertIsNot(reg.by_key[target_key].buffer, reg.by_key[draft_key].buffer)
+        DeepEPBuffer.set_dispatch_mode_as_normal()
+        DeepEPBuffer.set_dispatch_mode_as_low_latency()
+        self.assertEqual(
+            set(cleans),
+            {("target", (128, 7168, 256)), ("draft", (128, 7168, 64))},
